response.original_title: Mystery Science Theater 3000: The RiffTrax Experiments — The Mummy Theme Park
response.overview: The RiffTrax Experiments continue with Mummy Theme Park! All the best theme parks have “Theme Park” right in their names, right? That’s why the theme park in Jurassic Park turned out to be such a mess — if only they’d called it “Big Bitey Lizard Theme Park,” the guests would’ve known what they were in for.
